pages.text: Wherever something changes in proportion to how much of it there is, e appears. Some of the places it turns up in the mod:

$(li)$(thing)Reaction rates$(): Arrhenius, k = A·e^(−Eₐ/RT): every chemical machine's speed.$(li)$(thing)Radioactive decay$(): a source keeps e^(−t/τ) of its activity.$(li)$(thing)Boltzmann$(): a state of energy E is e^(−E/kT) as likely.$(li)$(thing)The Zeno Anchor$(): a system watched often enough never gets the chance to decay away.

$(li)$(thing)Waiting times$(): Gillespie, the next reaction after −ln(u)/a.$(li)$(thing)Control$(): a Governor's error falls as e^(−kt).$(li)$(thing)Statistics$(): the bell curve is e^(−x²/2); precision on a console falls off the same way.$(li)$(thing)The circle$(): e^(iθ) goes round it, and at θ = π reaches −1.
